description: The project is expected to attract global manufacturers, component suppliers, research and development centres and specialised technology service providers.
body_lead: Uttar Pradesh (UP) is preparing a comprehensive roadmap to position itself as a national hub for robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), quantum computing, semiconductors and other deep technologies, with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath directing officials to accelerate investments, build research infrastructure and expand the state's technology ecosystem beyond the National Capital Region.
